section.governanceHint: Every persona gets a human caretaker (default: whoever creates them). A backup covers time off.
field.name: Name
field.autonomyHint: Whether the persona executes within its mandate, proposes only, or waits for an explicit ask.
field.attentionBudgetHint: Caps pings: extra proposals roll into the daily summary, not the channel.
preview.label: Preview
subtitle.new: Describe who you need or build from scratch — you can change everything later.
subtitle.edit: Adjust who they are, what they can do and how much they act on their own.
builder.title: Describe who you need
builder.hint: In one sentence: the job, the tone and the tools. Coordination drafts it for you to review.
builder.placeholder: E.g.: Someone to answer customers calmly and check company memory before promising deadlines.
avatar.label: Appearance
avatar.pick: Pick an animal from the gallery
avatar.uploadHint: Square PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB. Stays on this computer.
avatar.silhouetteHint: A neutral silhouette, no animal — good for technical roles.
tool.filesystem.write: Reads and edits files (you review the deliveries).
tool.shell.read: Runs only read commands (list, read, test).
tool.shell.write: Runs commands that change things — use with care.
tool.web.write: Can also submit forms and post.
runner.label: Who runs it
runner.hint: The AI that does this persona's work on your computer. Hints come from our tests: who is fast and who finishes what they start.
autonomy.propose.desc: Suggests next steps and waits for your ok.
autonomy.act.desc: Executes within its mandate and tells you after.
role.coordination.desc: Takes requests in the channel, splits the work and answers for everyone. Only one per team.
role.watchdog.desc: Watches for anyone stuck or idle and nudges them.
preview.eyebrow: How the team will see it
gestor.title: Team manager
gestor.explain: {name} can hire personas, name them, and organize where each one works.
gestor.approval.ask.title: Always ask me
gestor.approval.ask.body: Shows the plan in chat and waits for your ok.
gestor.approval.autoWithin.title: Act alone within limits
gestor.approval.autoWithin.body: Hires and organizes without asking, as long as it fits the limits below.
gestor.approval.autoNotify.title: Act and tell me
gestor.approval.autoNotify.body: Acts and reports what it did in Overview.
gestor.canGrant: Can make another persona a team manager
gestor.canGrantHint: Off by default: only you assign this role.
gestor.ceiling: {name} never creates a persona with more access than they have.
